STEP 1 - Scene: A few strips of cooked bacon on a plate. This is a simple breakfast side.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square plate, about 24 cm across. Treated as square, its area is roughly 24 × 24 ≈ 576 cm², or about 450 cm² if counted as the usable circle. I used ~500 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: About 4 strips of crispy pan-fried bacon. No other food, oil or sauce is visible.

STEP 4 - Area: The bacon covers about 18% of the plate, which is roughly 90 cm².

STEP 5 - Volume: 90 cm² × 0.4 cm thickness (the strips are thin, curled and overlapping) ≈ 36 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: 36 ml × 0.9 ≈ 32 g. Cooked bacon strips weigh about 8–10 g each, so 4 strips gives about 35 g. I used 35 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g. 35 g × 5.4 ≈ 189 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Four strips of cooked bacon at about 35 g and 190 kcal is plausible.
